'''Traute, Princess of Lippe''' ({{langx|de|Traute Prinzessin zur Lippe}} {{IPA|de|ˈtʁaʊ̯tə pʁɪnˈt͜sɛsɪn t͜sʊʁ ˈlɪpə|}}; born '''Traute Becker''', 16 February 1925 – 25 February 2023) was a German princess, philanthropist, and biologist. She was a patron of the visual arts, the Princess Pauline Foundation, the [[Detmold|City of Detmold]], and the [[Lippe (district)|District of Lippe]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=27 February 2023 |title=Trauer um Traute Prinzessin zur Lippe |language=de |work=Westfalen Spiegel |url=https://www.westfalenspiegel.de/trauer-um-traute-prinzessin-zur-lippe/ |access-date=28 February 2023}}</ref> She was the bearer of the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany|Federal Cross of Merit]]. She was awarded a Crown Cross in gold from the [[Diakonie Deutschland|Diakonisches Werk]] in recognition of her social work.<ref name=":1">{{Cite news |date=26 February 2023 |title=Traute Prinzessin zur Lippe verstorben |language=de |work=Radio Lippe |url=https://www.radiolippe.de/nachrichten/lippe/detailansicht/traute-prinzessin-zur-lippe-verstorben.html |access-date=28 February 2023}}</ref>

==Biography==
Born in Hänigsen, [[Uetze]], [[Lower Saxony]], Traute was the daughter of Charlotte Meyer and Gustave Becker.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Annuaire de la noblesse moderne des maisons principales de l'Europe |publisher=Annuaire de la noblesse |year=2010 |pages=61 |language=fr |issn=1925-5594}}</ref> She earned a doctorate in biology.<ref name=":2">{{Cite news |date=26 February 2023 |title=Traute Prinzessin zur Lippe im Alter von 98 Jahren gestorben |language=de |work=LZ.de |url=https://www.lz.de/lippe/kreis_lippe/23495451_Prinzessin-Traute-zur-Lippe-im-Alter-von-98-Jahren-gestorben.html |access-date=28 February 2023}}</ref> Traute married Armin, Prince of Lippe, in [[Göttingen]], where they first met, on 27 March 1953.<ref name=":2" /><ref name=":4">{{Cite news |last=Glandien |first=Yvonne |date=2019 |title=Ein Porträt: Dr. Traute zur Lippe |language=de |work=Lippische Landeszeitung |editor-last=Akulenko |editor-first=Katarina |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tTL_lI6GaGk |access-date=28 February 2023 |via=YouTube}}</ref> He was head of the [[House of Lippe|House of Lippe]].<ref name=":5" />

In 1959, Traute gave birth to their son [[Stephan, Prince of Lippe]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite news |last=Fasel |first=Andreas |date=6 December 2015 |title=Umzug eines Prinzen |language=de |work=Welt am Sonntag |url=https://www.proquest.com/docview/1857360934 |access-date=28 February 2023 |id={{ProQuest|1857360934}} }}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite book |last=Willis |first=Daniel A. |title=The Reporter's Guide to the Royal Families of Europe |publisher=Bygone Era Books |year=2016 |isbn=9781941072325 |location=Denver, Colorado |pages=175}}</ref> She was regularly seen walking around Detmold with Prince Armin and their [[Scottish Terrier]] dog until Armin died in 2015.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" /> They were married for 62 years,<ref name=":4" /> and had five grandchildren.<ref name=":5" />

Princess Traute of Lippe was a board member of the [[Princess Pauline Foundation]] from 1979 to 2000 and served as chairman from 1983 to 1995.<ref name=":1" /> She was a founding member of the Lippische Gesellschaft für Kunst, along with Prince Armin, and served as its honorary chairman from 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |date=27 October 2021 |title=50 Jahre Lippische Gesellschaft für Kunst |url=https://www.owl-journal.de/50-jahre-lippische-gesellschaft-fuer-kunst/ |access-date=2023-03-01 |website=OWL Journal |language=de}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> In 2015, she also took over patronage of the MS-Kontaktkreis, a multiple sclerosis support group, following the death of Prince Armin and hosted its annual visit to Detmold Castle.<ref>{{Cite news |date=27 August 2016 |title=Prinzessin Traute ist neue Schirmherrin |language=de |work=Schaumburger Wochenblatt |url=https://www.schaumburger-wochenblatt.de/artikel/2016-08-27-prinzessin-traute-ist-neue-schirmherrin |access-date=28 February 2023}}</ref>

Princess Traute died at Detmold Castle on 25 February 2023, at the age of 98.<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":0" />
